title: Manipulating and Mitigating Generative Model Biases without Retraining

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images from neutral prompts (e.g., 'person') and using a CLIP zero-shot vision-classification model to classify the outputs and measure the frequency distribution of 'man' versus 'woman' representations.
Generating images from neutral prompts and using a CLIP zero-shot vision classifier to classify the outputs to measure the frequency distribution of 'young' versus 'old' representations.
Evaluating generated images from neutral prompts using a CLIP zero-shot vision classifier to determine the frequency distribution of 'white', 'black', and 'asian' representations.
